description: This file defines the DatabaseQueryService interface which declares methods for querying database schema information such as table presence, columns, and indexes within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: DatabaseQueryService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for executing database schema queries like checking table existence, retrieving columns, and indexes.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the database query service is supported in the current environment.

methods.name: isTablePresent
methods.description: Determines if a specific table exists in the provided DataSource.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Retrieves the columns of a specified table. Note: currently returns a raw SqlRowSet, with a TODO to improve to a custom POJO.

methods.name: getTableIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index details for a specified table.
